mainEntity.name: What is an RWA tokenization PR agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a PR partner who knows how to frame tokenized real-world assets for two different audiences at once: the institutional finance press (Bloomberg, Forbes, Reuters) that needs to see regulatory clarity and credible custodians, and the crypto media (CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt) that needs to see protocol mechanics and on-chain proof. Shilika Jain runs RWA PR directly at $5K–$12K/month, with the MANTRA Chain CoinDesk exclusive as the benchmark.

mainEntity.name: Who is RWA tokenization PR actually for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protocols tokenizing real assets such as treasuries, credit, real estate, commodities or trade finance. Also relevant for the infrastructure layer: custody providers, compliance tooling and settlement rails serving RWA issuers. If your project is pitching to institutional capital and also needs crypto community credibility, this is the right service.

mainEntity.name: What does RWA tokenization PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator retainer runs $5K–$12K/month, covering strategy, direct outreach and ongoing coverage management. mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you actually place RWA stories in?

acceptedAnswer.text: For crypto-native coverage: CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, Cointelegraph, The Defiant. For institutional and mainstream crossover: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Coverage in each outlet requires a real news angle.
